parties.respondent: Jammu and Kashmir National Conference & Anr.

summary: Election symbol allocation dispute; Plough symbol for Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council elections; applicability of Election Symbols (Reservation and Allotment) Order, 1968; scope of authority of Election Commission of India versus Union Territory Election Authority; concession under para 10 of 1968 Order; interim orders of High Court upheld; non-compliance with judicial orders; urgency due to election timeline; preclusion from selective application of provisions; harmonious interpretation of symbols order.
legal_provisions_cited: Election Symbols (Reservation and Allotment) Order, 1968, para 9
Election Symbols (Reservation and Allotment) Order, 1968, para 10
Election Symbols (Reservation and Allotment) Order, 1968, para 10(A)
The Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Councils (Election) Rules, 1995, Rule 5
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court's judgment upheld; Union Territory directed to notify Plough symbol as reserved symbol for Jammu and Kashmir National Conference in LAHDC elections.
